Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring the Columbia River Gorge commission to compensate property owners for certain zoning changes.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the zoning authority of the Columbia River Gorgecommission; and adding a new section to chapter 43.97 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.97 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1)(a) If the commission has zoned an existing property or parcelin such a way that prohibits development of that property or parcel andthe property or parcel is within an incorporated city's limits or waspurchased before January 1, 1987, the commission shall: (i) Grant, by any process, a single building permit for thatproperty or parcel; or (ii) Compensate the owner for the value of the property or parcelat its current, residential, fair market value as if the permit hadbeen granted. (b) The assessor of the county to which the property in questionbelongs shall determine the compensatory amount. (2) If the commission does not grant a permit or compensation as p. 1 SB 5152required by subsection (1) of this section, then the legislature willnot renew the commission's appropriation for the next biennium.
